final: WITH c AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS n FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS a, SUM(n) AS t FROM c), x AS (SELECT c.n, s.a, s.t FROM c, s WHERE c.n > s.a) SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(n * 1.0 / t) AS avg_fraction_of_total, AVG(n - a) AS avg_excess FROM x
